decision: Accepted as source-structured CPU parsing and logical-writer join prototype; real device metadata remains unobserved
root_findings: Read decoder and mapper implementations, directory prefix code and actual ownership helpers. Complete per-rank return metadata plus local expert counts identifies each final occurrence; original source dst and topk_idx cross-check its destination and expert.
Original Notify stride and lazily re-encoded power-of-two Dispatch stride are different. The join consumes original signed dst using max(1,max(rank_rows)); mixing the representations rejects.

Cross-rank primary pair tables and gateway forward records identify final logical writers without preserving temporary Notify meta or bases. forward_list source is the outer partition; column0 is token-group record-end and column5 is gatherrow, never topk slot.

Self-primary partition uses the actual front-loaded-remainder DispatchSplitRange helper, not a floor(total*worker/workers) approximation. Local expansion uses the rotated full CSR base source*T*K before filtering target rows.

The join checks exact route/final-occurrence coverage, matching source/token/slot/expert, unique primary pairs and secondary records, and relay/direct consistency. It handles five final-writer paths in coherent synthetic16-rank samples, including duplicate expert occurrences and empty/tail cases.
Output explicitly retains native_domain=null and seq=null. CrossQp index and logical role do not establish the SDK slot/state alias identity or actual source-ready-dependent submission order.
limits: No actual NPU dump was used. The9 decoder and13 join checks are distinct source-structured synthetic tests; previously accepted18+10 protocol tests were not rerun or counted again.
The parser/join scope is reviewed normal server-dedup8 and world8/16. Future device exports must bind dedup/config/source/native identity rather than assuming unsupported modes share this layout.
Temporary raw meta/bases need not be exported for this logical join. Actual physical SQ aliases and Dispatch generation still require a separate bounded observation; plan ABI8 is not an epoch.
next_metadata_diagnostic_requirements: Use a separately reviewed bounded diagnostic to export already-persistent handle fields after completed Notify, with exact source/library/config/rank/session identity and actual original stride. Do not mutate the currently approved EP16 or P4 worker/controller to add this export.

Export only initialized array ranges. Unused pair rows, forward padding, scratch and mutable mailbox bytes are not meaningful immutable metadata; record any canonical zero-fill of unexported ranges explicitly rather than claiming a complete raw device-memory dump.

Join all rank exports offline and require exact coverage before feeding normalized Expected entries into the readiness model. Do not infer native domains or dynamic sequence numbers from logical names.
Retain no performance qualification from diagnostic copies or source-level parsing. No metadata device run is authorized by this review.
